<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.33.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* Require explicit suggestion of unsafe_allow_html in st.write by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8238
### New Features 🎉
* explicit update() method for query_params by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8205
* Add `AreaChartColumn` to column config by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8237
* Associate label with input to make label click focus input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8155
* Media elements improvements by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8203
* Page switching in AppTest by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8280
* Add ability to use timedelta and stings to `start_time` and `end_time`. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8348
* st.experimental_fragment decorator by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8343
* Feature: `st.html` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8366
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* AppTest format_func by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8189
* Url decode link column display values if regex is used by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8258
* Fix infinite loop when `rerun` and triggered widgets are used together in AppTest by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8264
* Use the button width as minimum for `st.popover` container by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8266
* Revert "Expire session storage cache on an async timer (#8083)" by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8281
* Allow custom themes to override embed options query parameter by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8021
* Fix issue with not correctly waiting for connections by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8294
* Fix initial iframe height for custom component by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8290
* Fullscreen Button Overflow Horizontally by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8279
* Fix white components backgrounds when OS is using dark theme by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8242
* Add simple fix to update container status after llm complete by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8311
* Simplify toast message truncation to use character limit directly by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8337
* resolve path when registering watcher for module paths by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8372
* Readd mistakenly removed line and add explanatory comment by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8392
### Other Changes
* Allow packaging 24.x by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8338

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8155
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8311
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8372

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.32.2...1.33.0
